_about: Krish's cartoon character: where its inputs and its drawn library live, whether he has approved the base, and the numbers ve places it by. Only this manifest is in git; every image (his photo, the house style image, the base, the poses) lives in his asset library and is never committed (AGENTS.md). Asked for by Krish, 2026-11-09: "I will put a character in to it as well later this week, so ensure that is ready too." Craft: _corpus/keyframes-character.md. Cards: docs/ve/cards/keyframes/ve-kf-6-character-library.md (draws the library) and ve-kf-7-character-layer.md (places it in a cut). A spec may name a character (spec.character) only once approved is true, the library is built and the character_layer device is registered; until then ve lint refuses it (character.* lines, scripts/velib/character.py).

approval.of: base.png (version 2: longer sleeves and no earbud, his notes on version 1: "longer sleeves, get rid of the ear bud in my right ear")

home._root: runtime.library_root in config/studio.json (MINDMAKE_LIBRARY_ROOT): makeyourmindup, Drive 1HHI0u24N3o3-yeprQzHdXVZtA7cNcKxh. The brand kit is permanent, beside photography/editor, which already holds his two editor photos.

photo.rule: One clear photo of Krish facing the camera, head and shoulders, in the top he wants the character to wear; JPG or PNG (an iPhone HEIC is turned into JPG first: the image tool and the library path rule do not take HEIC). A small, blurry or side-on photo is asked for again once.

notes.rule: Optional, in his words: anything the photo cannot show (eye colour, hair under a cap), and his taste ("keep my glasses on", "never arms crossed"). Copied verbatim into identity.md and preferences.md; never paraphrased into his voice.

style_image.from: the original zip, assets/character/style.png (docs/ve/sources/keyframes.md). It gives the drawing style and the framing only, never who the character is.

example_sheet.from: the original zip, assets/character/example-sheet.png: the house character's poses, the bar for the library.

drawing._route: GPT Image 2 through Codex signed in with ChatGPT (Krish's subscription; no API key, no other paid service). When Codex says its image tool is unavailable, stop and say so; the fallback is ChatGPT by hand with the sheet prompts, never another provider. Drawing in code is not offered: it looks much worse.

acting._spots: The pack's spots. Here the bust's opaque pixels never enter a channel's action rail or top bar (config/channel-safe-zones.json), the caption region or the key part of the beat's picture: the layer moves the bust inward or sinks it until they clear, and refuses a cue it cannot clear. The right spot will mostly clamp inward, since Instagram's rail starts at x 880. Its head sits inside the handle and caption band (from y 1320), where nothing that must be read may go; the bust is not text, and Krish judges that at his first look.
acting._aspects: The pack placed it on 1080x1920 only. A 16:9 placement waits for its own measured spot and Krish's look.
